title: Sports Agent: A Self-Evolving System for Conversational Data Analytics
abstract: arXiv:2611.33700v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conversational sports analytics requires accurate, evidence-based responses with low latency. Changes in query distributions, data resources, and model behavior can degrade static agent configurations, motivating controlled evolution guided by runtime evidence.   We present Sports Agent, a self-evolving framework integrating an Agentic SQL Model for structured-data reasoning, a harness for planning and tool orchestration, and a unified Feedback Engine connecting online execution with offline evolution. The engine assesses responses and execution trajectories, verifies factual claims, diagnoses failures, and generates evolution signals. Model evolution combines SQL-to-Question Scaling for coverage expansion with Graph-Guided Scaling for error-targeted synthesis. Generated questions undergo trajectory distillation and quality filtering for iterative supervised fine-tuning, followed by a separate Post-RL stage. Harness evolution translate

translated_title: Sports Agent：一个面向对话式数据分析的自进化系统
translated_abstract: 对话式体育分析需要准确、有据可依且低延迟的响应。查询分布、数据资源和模型行为的变化会导致静态智能体配置的性能退化，这促使我们探索由运行时证据引导的受控进化。我们提出 Sports Agent，一个自进化框架，它集成了用于结构化数据推理的智能体 SQL 模型、用于规划与工具编排的执行框架，以及连接在线执行与离线进化的统一反馈引擎。该引擎评估响应与执行轨迹、验证事实性断言、诊断失败原因并生成进化信号。模型进化结合了用于覆盖面扩展的 SQL-to-Question Scaling 与面向错误针对性合成的 Graph-Guided Scaling。生成的问题经过轨迹蒸馏与质量过滤，用于迭代式监督微调，随后进行独立的 Post-RL 阶段。Harness 进化将……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Sports Agent 提出了一个由运行时反馈驱动的自进化框架，通过统一的反馈引擎结合 SQL-to-Question Scaling 与 Graph-Guided Scaling 等策略，使对话式体育数据分析智能体能够持续自我改进并保持回答的准确性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: Sports Agent introduces a self-evolving framework driven by runtime feedback, which combines a unified Feedback Engine with SQL-to-Question Scaling and Graph-Guided Scaling to enable conversational sports analytics agents to continuously self-improve and maintain accurate, evidence-based responses.
